Name: Jahath, Overseer
Summary: Jahath, a Levite of the sons of Merari, was an overseer of the workmen repairing the house of the LORD under Josiah, and the men did the work faithfully.
KeyStory: The overseers of the repair were Jahath and Obadiah, Levites of the sons of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam of the Kohathites.
LifeLesson: Faithful oversight kept the temple repair honest.
